summary: Exxon PP block copo 1,530 CIF, SCG copo ~1,510; domestic traders VND 43,500-44,000/kg
NSRP 114G cut to VND 39,000/kg (-200, lowest PP yarn); market settles 39,500-39,800 flat
Sabic copo 36/37MK10 offered domestically at 37,900-38,500 (below PP yarn); OG SK/Hanwha copo at 32,000-33,000
paras: According to sources today, October 7, offers for Exxon Mobil PP block copolymer shipped from Singapore to Vietnam are being recorded at USD 1,530/tonne/CIF. SCG of Thailand's distributor offered PP copolymer to the Vietnamese market in VND, equivalent to about USD 1,510/tonne/CIF at USD conversion. In the domestic market, traders are offering these grades at VND 43,500-44,000/kg including VAT.

Import PP homopolymer offers to Vietnam early this week are fairly sparse, mainly because Chinese suppliers are on holiday (resuming tomorrow, October 8), while offers from Thailand's IRPC and Sabic announced last week were too high.

Conversely, some sources said Vietnamese-plant PP homopolymer (yarn/injection) is being offered for export by distributors to the Indonesian market at high prices of USD 1,390-1,400/tonne/CIF. Reportedly, this price level has been accepted by some buyers, as imported PP homopolymer price levels in Indonesia are currently ranging USD 1,400-1,420/tonne/CIF. With high export prices achievable, some plants — typically Hyosung Vina — are currently prioritizing exports, leaving limited domestic offer volumes…

Even so, domestic PP offer and transaction prices this week are holding flat to easing slightly. Notably, a leading NSRP distributor adjusted its PP 114G offer down to VND 39,000/kg including VAT, down VND 200/kg from last week. This is the lowest PP yarn price recorded. In the market, most traders are still closing sales in the VND 39,500-39,800/kg including VAT range, flat.

In the south, PP yarn offers from domestic plants such as BSR and Hyosung Vina were also mainly held flat in the VND 39,500-40,000/kg including VAT range, with transaction prices recorded only at around VND 39,500/kg including VAT. “In fact, some sellers persist in holding offers high, but with PP yarn at VND 40,000/kg including VAT and above, almost all finished-goods producers are running at a loss,” a southern source said.

Chinese- and Korean-origin imported PP homopolymer grades are commonly in the VND 39,000-40,000/kg including VAT range depending on grade and distributor, mostly held flat since late last week. At the higher end, another southern distributor offered Thailand's IRPC PP 1102K at VND 44,000/kg including VAT and IRPC PP Film 1126NK at up to VND 45,500/kg including VAT…

The same survey today still found northern sellers offering Sabic PP copolymer 36MK10, 37MK10 and 310MK10 at only VND 37,900-38,500/kg including VAT; South Korea's SK PP homopolymer at only VND 37,500/kg including VAT and SK PP random at VND 38,500/kg including VAT… Other traders raised each of these grades this week by about VND 500-700/kg, to VND 38,400-39,000/kg including VAT, after fairly large volumes were consumed last week.

“Import offers for Sabic PP copolymer grades 36MK10 and 37MK10… to Vietnam are now high, up to USD 1,435-1,450/tonne/CIF, so the fact that many sellers offer domestically at cheap levels of VND 38,000-38,500/kg including VAT — lower even than PP yarn — may be because of stock imported when prices were cheap. By reports, the domestic PP copolymer market has recently consumed fairly slowly. Meanwhile, some trading companies holding off-grade (OG) PP copolymer of SK and Hanwha (South Korea) origin, in bulk, are offering at cheap prices of only VND 32,000-33,000/kg including VAT, putting competitive pressure on prime PP copolymer,” a northern source analyzed.

Trading sentiment in the resin market this week is generally quite subdued and cautious; both sellers and buyers are waiting for adjustments from the Chinese market after the holiday ends on October 7 to gauge the October trend more clearly.

summary: LSP CP Chem HDPE blow 5502 cut to VND 43,400/kg (-400) yet high; US HDPE blow deal at only 39,000
Mid-East LLDPE Film holds VND 42,000-43,000 (43k a resistance line); US-origin ~41,000-41,500
Late-Oct/Nov Chinese LLDPE at only 38,500-39,000 — downward pressure building; LDPE Film cooling to 45,000-45,500
paras: Today, October 7, LSP's office adjusted its offer for CP Chem Singapore-origin HDPE blow 5502 down slightly by VND 400/kg from last week, to VND 43,400/kg including VAT. Even so, this offer is still considered too high and few buyers are contracting imports. The reason is that a deal has now been recorded for US-origin HDPE blow at only VND 39,000/kg including VAT, and more US-origin material is expected to arrive in the country soon. This week, Cynpol (US) HDPE blow was offered to Vietnam at USD 1,210/tonne/CIF, while US Montachem HDPE blow is being offered at USD 1,240/tonne/CIF…

HDPE Film/yarn/injection grades are trading fairly slowly, with traders inclined to hold prices flat or ease slightly from late last week; sentiment on adjusting remains cautious. The lowest spot price recorded for HDPE Film is VND 39,000/kg including VAT, for Chinese material, flat since late last week. Thailand's PTT HDPE yarn 5000S was offered at around VND 41,000/kg including VAT…

This week, PTT of Thailand's distributor just adjusted its HDPE Film/yarn and LLDPE injection offers down to USD 1,420/tonne/CIF, USD 30/tonne below the late-August level, with little LLDPE volume and no LDPE offered. Meanwhile, offers for China's STL HDPE Film FS7000 eased USD 5-10/tonne from the previous week, to USD 1,335-1,340/tonne/CIF.

For LLDPE, according to a survey, Middle Eastern-origin PE such as Sabic and Qamar (Saudi Arabia) remains scarce for prompt delivery; PE cargoes from China originally expected for September delivery are mostly still delayed; and US-origin PE import cargoes are expected to arrive from this week.

“In fact, some import cargoes of Middle Eastern LLDPE Film have arrived in scattered lots since last week, but volumes are small, enough only to deliver to customers who contracted earlier, or sellers are rushing to sell quickly to lock in profits. Spot offer volumes on the market are small, so most sellers hold offers flat from late last week, with Middle Eastern-origin LLDPE Film commonly in the VND 42,000-43,000/kg including VAT range; US-origin LLDPE Film is also offered at a high level of around VND 41,000-41,500/kg including VAT,” a source said.

One northern seller said they had closed sales of Sabic (Saudi Arabia) LLDPE FD21HS or 218WJ at VND 42,800-43,000/kg including VAT, depending on volume, but when they raised to VND 43,200/kg including VAT, buyers refused to import. This suggests VND 43,000/kg including VAT is a resistance threshold. Yesterday, October 6, Qamar (Saudi Arabia)'s distributor offered LLDPE Film FD21HS/FC21HS… at a Hai Phong bonded warehouse at USD 1,480/tonne, for prompt delivery within 1-2 weeks, but this price level has not yet attracted buyers.

Notably, late-October to early-November LLDPE Film cargoes of Chinese origin were offered at only VND 38,500-39,000/kg including VAT, and even for Middle Eastern LLDPE Film for late-October to early-November delivery, some sellers offered at VND 40,000-40,500/kg including VAT. Downward price pressure on LLDPE is therefore building.

For LDPE, a northern seller disclosed having closed sales of Lotte Titan Malaysia LDPE Film 260GG at VND 46,000/kg including VAT to retail buyers, although the offer was up to VND 47,000/kg including VAT. Many other sellers also said LDPE Film transaction prices this week are cooling, with LDPE Film of Sabic, Tasnee, Lotte Titan, PTT… origin mainly recorded in the VND 45,000-45,500/kg including VAT range, although some sellers still offer up to VND 48,000/kg including VAT.

On imports, this week the distributor of Malaysia's Petlin offered LDPE Film C150Y or N125Y to Vietnam at USD 1,565/tonne/CFR HCMC, for about 8-10 containers. Saudi Arabia's Tasnee adjusted its offers for PE grades to the Vietnamese market: LDPE Film 1925AS/4025AS was offered down USD 25/tonne from late last week to USD 1,525/tonne/CFR, and LDPE Film 0725N down USD 25/tonne to USD 1,540/tonne/CFR…, with a total offered LDPE volume of more than 1,000 tonnes. The distributor for Ciplas — an Itochu US affiliate — offered LDPE Film and mLLDPE Film to Vietnam this week down USD 25/tonne from last week, to USD 1,210-1,220/tonne/CFR…

In addition, early this week offers for Tasnee HDPE injection IM2050 fell sharply by USD 70/tonne to USD 1,230/tonne/CFR; HDPE 100 black was held flat at USD 1,325/tonne/CFR…, for November 2026 delivery. Saudi Arabia's Sabic HDPE pipe black was offered at USD 1,340/tonne/CIF. Cynpol (US) announced bid-taking prices for PE cargoes for December 2026 delivery to Vietnam: LLDPE 6118 C6 at USD 1,250/tonne/CIF; LLDPE/mLLDPE 0318 C4 offered at USD 1,270/tonne/CIF…

summary: AGC (ASC/AVT Oct cargoes) at USD 825-830 CIF, -25-30 vs two weeks ago; trading still thin
Shintech (US) lifted SE950/SE1000 bid to 790-800 CIF (+~20) on Oct-Nov plant maintenance plans
Sept PVC imports >81,000 t at ~USD 740 avg; cheap US SE950/SE1000 (620-650) keep arriving, capping Oct upside
paras: ThitruongHatnhua.com (Oct 5) — Imported PVC prices into Vietnam are mixed: US-origin offers were adjusted up while other Asian supply stays under pressure from weak buying demand.

AGC Group's distributor settled October 2026 PVC cargoes from Ashahimas Indonesia (ASC) and Vinythai Thailand (AVT) at USD 825-830/tonne CIF for Vietnamese buyers, down USD 25-30/tonne from offers two weeks earlier. Actual trading volume remained thin, suggesting buyers are not yet restocking aggressively despite the lower adjustment.

Conversely, Shintech (US) raised its bid for PVC SE950/SE1000 delivered to Vietnam to USD 790-800/tonne CIF, up about USD 20/tonne from early last month. Cargoes are expected to arrive in January 2027. The higher level is supported by Shintech's plan to idle some PVC plants for maintenance in October-November 2026, raising supply concerns ahead.

Domestically, Shintech (US) PVC SE950 rose VND 300/kg to VND 24,500-25,000/kg at buyers' warehouses in Hanoi, up 1.23% from the prior week-end (Oct 2). All other PVC grades in the price table held steady.

On supply, Vietnam imported more than 81,000 tonnes of PVC in September at an average import price of about USD 740/tonne. Notably, a significant volume of US-origin PVC SE950/SE1000 contracted earlier at around USD 620-650/tonne continues to arrive in October.

This low-priced inflow may add competitive pressure to the domestic market while end-demand has yet to truly improve. Hence, even though some US PVC offers are rising on supply factors, the domestic PVC price level in October is still unlikely to climb sharply.
